note: Code in src/ that reads a stored record with getMemory and later writes the same key back with setMemory or writeMemoryRecord, with no version condition (check:atomic-writes, scripts/inventory/atomic-writes.ts). Seeded 2026-10-18 with every hit read by hand. Each line is one of two things: "Safe: <the fact that makes it safe>", where "not a read-then-write" marks a hit the detector got wrong, or "DEBT: unversioned read-then-write; reason in Platform Development Notes doc-mve1mtynyrma", which pnpm debt counts as open. What an open site lets two requests at the same moment do is written in that non-public note, never in this public file. In-process locks and boot chains do not count as safe: aimeat.io has run two node processes on one database (services/scheduler-fire-claim.ts). The list only shrinks: fix a DEBT entry with updateRecord() in services/record-cas.ts or setMemoryIfVersion, then delete its line.

exempt.src/routes/agents/offers.ts:PUT /v1/agen: Safe: not a read-then-write: the PUT replaces the whole offers list; the read supplies only the version counter, createdAt and the old text for the ODPS size check, and the last PUT wins.
exempt.src/routes/memory/copy.ts:POST /v1/memor: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read at line 106 is the source owner's public record (source_gaii); the write is the caller's own record. The caller's read at line 137 gives only version, createdAt and the old level.
exempt.src/services/a2a-foreign.ts:identifyFore: Safe: the write after the read happens only when the presented key equals the pinned one, and it writes that same key and kid back with the last-seen time and the card's addresses; two requests at the same moment differ only in lastSeenAt. (2026-10-27, secaudit2026oct26: the pin key moved into a variable, which made the detector see the pair it did not see before.)
exempt.src/services/adult-assurance.ts:recordAd: Safe: both writes set adult: true; two verifications at the same moment can only drop one method's timestamp from the methods map, which nothing in src reads.
exempt.src/services/agent-offers-write.ts:publi: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read only takes the edition counter; the write replaces the whole offers document from the request body.
exempt.src/services/ai/provider-store.ts:putOwn: Safe: the PUT replaces the whole provider record; the read only carries the health of unchanged models, and a health entry lost here is best effort and is written again on the next status change.
exempt.src/services/ai/roles.ts:writeRoles|ROLE: Safe: ai.roles.requests is only a list the AI page shows; a request the race loses or brings back is written again at the app's next unbound call, as the docblock says a later call asks again.
exempt.src/services/ai/roles.ts:noteRoleUsed|RO: Safe: ai.roles.used only feeds the last-used text on the AI page (read at roles.ts:429, nothing deletes by it); a lost timestamp is written again at that role's next use after a day.
exempt.src/services/ai/roles.ts:noteRoleRequest: Safe: ai.roles.requests is only a list the AI page shows; a request lost when two apps ask at once is written again at that app's next unbound call after a day.
exempt.src/services/app-audit-archive.ts:writeK: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read only takes version and createdAt; the value written is the new keep setting alone.
exempt.src/services/app-members.ts:noteVisit|se: Safe: the visits field is a display count that limits nothing; two loads at the same moment can only count one visit fewer, with the same firstSeen and lastSeen.
exempt.src/services/call-timing.ts:flushCallTim: Safe: two processes flushing at once lose only the timing samples and count of one batch, and these feed a displayed p50/p95 that limits nothing.
exempt.src/services/datapackage/version-audienc: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read only takes created, version and createdAt; the manifest value is rebuilt from the descriptor.
exempt.src/services/decide/providers.ts:putOwne: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read only checks that a stored api key exists to decide a 400; the write stores the new api_key from the request body and uses nothing it read.
exempt.src/services/hooks-overview.ts:settleSto: Safe: the settle is idempotent: a second process reads the same stored bindings and actions and writes the same hooks values and marker; at most the Hooks page logs a removed reference twice.
exempt.src/services/hooks-overview.ts:moveAccou: Safe: the move is idempotent: a second process reads the same bindings, actions and account identities, and writes the same id#<GHII> values and the same marker.
exempt.src/services/packages/peer/package-peer-: Safe: the marker is write-once with the same shape; two refused registrations at once write the same marker, and the worst case is a second copy of the same operator incident note.
exempt.src/services/skill-seeds.ts:seedBuiltinS: Safe: the seed is idempotent: two processes of one build publish the same SKILL.md body and write the same fingerprint stamp for each skill.
exempt.src/services/workflow/store.ts:saveWorkf: Safe: not a read-then-write: the read only supplies createdBy, createdAt and the version number; the definition written comes entirely from the request.
